requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and role-based access control to protect attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and updates within 2 seconds to maintain accurate attendance records.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to comply with regulations.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed efficiently to provide updates while minimizing energy consumption.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide an option to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
